description: §19.3.3 E-ERROR-009 against the compiler-provided `SqlError` (§19.8.4: a built-in ENUM) — `fail SqlError.Bogus("boom")` names a variant SqlError does not have (QueryFailed, ConstraintViolation, ConnectionLost). The twin of error/fail-variant-undeclared-neg for the built-in error type. Incidental W-DEAD-FUNCTION/W-PROGRAM-001 ignored by superset matching.
provenance: lane:s479-records (PA-cleanup — g-impl1-fail-site-unchecked-against-sqlerror-s474: the SPEC already requires it; impl#1 carried divergence)
rationale: §19.3.3: "A variant that does not belong to the declared error type SHALL be a compile error: E-ERROR-009 … This covers a variant undeclared by the declared enum"; §19.8.4: "`SqlError` SHALL be a built-in enum type provided by the compiler." So SqlError's variant set is the one a `fail` is checked against.

codes: severity:code 'E-ERROR-009' did not fire (expected severity error)
